t: This is 50 St James's Street, a Grade Two listed house in St James's, standing opposite White's Club. It was designed by the architects Benjamin Dean Wyatt and Philip Wyatt, both members of the Wyatt family. Philip was the youngest son of the architect James Wyatt. In more recent times the house was owned by Andrey Goncharenko, a Russian billionaire businessman and former chief executive of a Gazprom subsidiary. He bought four central London houses for a total of two hundred and fifty million pounds, and this was one of them.
